comment: Which Jira ticket covers which theme, per domain. The theme-ticket skill maintains this when it creates or fills in a ticket; the build-order page reads it to show each theme's tickets on its card. A theme whose only ticket is the stub raised at split time records it under the domain "stub". A "common" ticket summarises behaviour both frontends share; its scenarios are already counted in the theme's domain tickets. rowScopes lists, for a theme delivered as several tickets rather than one theme branch, the Jira keys its row commits are scoped by, so tim theme-ticket derive can find the theme's footprint.
